_comment: Per-app locale support of the upstream Everything apps (scanned from the upstream source; spreadsheet verified in e2e US-55). FoxOS passes its language to every app through the Chromium locale (navigator.language / navigator.languages).

spreadsheet.how: upstream i18n (src/i18n, zh-Hans catalogs): ?lang= > in-app choice > navigator.languages; FoxOS sets the Chromium locale (--lang), so the UI follows FoxOS
